name: native-demo-app-mobile-tests
description: Mobile test automation project for native-demo-app using Appium, WebdriverIO, JavaScript, and Mocha, with Page Object Model structure and BrowserStack support for Android and iOS real-device testing.

scripts.validate:config: node -e "require('./config/wdio.android.local.conf'); require('./config/wdio.android.conf'); require('./config/wdio.ios.conf'); console.log('WDIO configs loaded')"
scripts.report:clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); ['allure-results', 'allure-report'].forEach((dir) => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));"
scripts.test:mobile: npm run test:android && npm run test:ios
